description:
The most recent comments (up to 15) on an Instagram post or reel by URL or shortcode: text, time, likes, GIFs and author, plus the post's total comment count.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Provide one of: `url` OR `shortcode`.
Returns: shortcode (string), link (string), comment_count (integer, nullable), comments (array<object>), comments_fetched (integer), has_more (boolean).

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return. Logged-out Instagram exposes the 15 newest top-level comments. Example: 15

shortcode.description: Post shortcode; alias used only when url is empty. Example: "DYxz0A8Kinw"

url.description: Post, reel or IGTV URL (a bare shortcode also works). Example: "https://www.instagram.com/reel/DYxz0A8Kinw/"

name: instagram_comments
title: Instagram comments
